integrity.statement: The all-integer valuation criterion and divergent-gap dichotomy are deduced from the published 2014 full Parikh spectrum; the 2024 one-parameter preservation theorem and examples are acknowledged as prior work. The executable checks cover finite samples only.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to the fixed point 0->012, 1->02, 2->1, integer scalar valuations and the stated subsequence of lengths. Published 2014 Parikh-spectrum lemmas are essential premises; finite tests do not replace those proofs. Claims of absolute bibliographic priority are not made.
title: An arithmetic dichotomy for valuations of the ternary Thue word
